HxResult HxCursorGetHidden ( bool *  pHidden  ) 

Check if the cursor has been hidden pending movement.

This function will return the hidden status of the cursor. This will be true if there had been a call to HxCursorHideUntilMoved and the user had not yet touched the trackpoint or mouse to move the cursor.

Parameters:
pHidden Points to hidden value of cursor
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if succesful, HX_NULL_POINTER if pHidden is NULL.

HxResult HxCursorHideUntilMoved ( HxWidget_t *  pWidget,
int32_t  x,
int32_t  y 
)

Hide the cursor until the user moves it again.

This function will hide the cursor until it is moved by the user. This is usually used when processing keyboard or wheel events to make the cursor get out of the way of the user while they are using the device by an alternate means. Internally, this sets a flag in the window manager that hides the cursor from the screen, but any input from the user will unhide it.

The cursor is warped to the widget's location plus the x,y offset. This is useful for directing mouse events to a particular control. When the mouse is moved, it will be restored to it's original location by the window manager.

Parameters:
pWidget NULL if cursor should stay in same position, or pointer to widget or window to use as coordinate base for mouse button events
x x offset from top-left of pWidget or 0
y y offset from top-left of pWidget or 0
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if succesful.

HxResult HxCursorSetPosition ( int32_t  x,
int32_t  y 
)

Set the cursor's location.

HxCursorSetPosition sets the cursor location. The coordinates are relative to the display, not to the windows.

If (x, y) is set to (0, 0), for example, the cursor is drawn at the top left corner of the application bar.

If x < 0, cursor's x coordinate is set to 0, and no error is returned. If y < 0, cursor's y coordinate is set to 0, and no error is returned. If x > display width, x is set to display width, and no error is returned. If x > display height, x is set to display height, and no error is returned.

Parameters:
x IN: x coordinate
y IN: y coordinate
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK.
